text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marve-lous☆
Marve-lous★
Marve, Marve-lous☆★☆

Marvelous Sunday stood on the training track.
Today, she was showing even more enthusiasm than usual.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Alright, done stretchiiing☆
Trainer! Can I run now!?
Can I start!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, just don't push yourself too hard—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yay! Off I go, Marvelous-ly☆★☆

She leaves mid-conversation.
...Then again, perhaps her hyperactive state
is only to be expected.
"You see, at the fan event held this morning—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You too, and you too☆ Let's sing togetherrr★
If everyone sings, it's Marvelouuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Gathered Fans
text_block_list.text: Marvelouuus!!!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what's this? Looks pretty lively～
……Huh, I might know that girl over there?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Ah! The one who debuted a little while ago...
Marvelous Sunday, was it?
She always seems so energetic and fun.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean it's a fan event?
Let's go check it out too. Sounds like fun♪

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text: Man, that's quite a turnout! Or rather... the passion levels are through the roof, aren't they? I wonder if all Mave-san fans are like this...?

She ran through the Junior Class in races where she could feel the marvelousness.
It's safe to say the goal of raising her name recognition has been achieved.

While she doesn't have an overwhelming number of fans,
it seems more and more people are gradually
starting to notice her charm.

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, watching made me a little envious.
I don't have anything I love quite that much, so—

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text: Wait, hmm? H-Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Maaaarvelouuuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Are you feeling marvelous today?
I am totally marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Because this is a fateful encounter☆
Our hearts seeking the Marvelous have connected us★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy I got to meet you, Marvelous!
I have high hopes for your Classics too!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Thank you!
Meeting all of you makes me super-duper marvelous too☆

text_block_list.name: Gathered Fans
text_block_list.text: Marvelous! Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text: W-What is this...? What... am I seeing...?

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
――Huh!?
Wait, huh, I'm back where I started...!?

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Was it just my imagination...!?
No, but... she was definitely right there a moment ago...!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
I-I really want to know...! Trainer-san!
What on earth does 'Marvelous' even mean!?

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text: That's...?!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
"The answer is in there?!
Th-Then...!"

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely coming next time!!
And I want to know...
what "marvelous" really is...!!
And so, after gaining a few more marvelous candidates, the fan event ended on a high note—

Fueled by the cheers, Marvelous Sunday's motivation
exploded. And so, she dedicated herself
to her afternoon training.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's support is super-duper marvelous☆
If more and more people come to watch me like this—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "The chances to share Marvelous with everyone are growing more and more and more☆★☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
So that in the race where everyone comes to watch,
I can deliver an even more marvelous run☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Marvelous World Domination Plan", Step One! ☆
Train a whole bunch and get a marvelous, super-strong run!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's run even faster and fartherーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelouuuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Aha☆
Ahahaha★
Ahahahahaha☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...
As expected, the Marvelous is overflowing—!

True to her word, Marvelous Sunday showed off
a marvelous run packed with incredible speed.

Graceful, powerful, impossible to look away from.
It felt as though... she was breaking through some kind of limit—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Kh—?!

Regrettable.
...Calling out to her came just one step too late.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
There's severe inflammation in your right knee.
It was a stroke of luck in misfortune that you came to see a doctor immediately instead of leaving it alone.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Please rest for a while. Once the swelling and pain subside,
you may begin rehabilitation starting with range-of-motion exercises.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
However, there are still things
I would like you to be mindful of moving forward—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
A developing skeleton naturally has areas that are prone to fragility during the growth process,
but in Marvelous Sunday's case, it's particularly—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Her bone strength cannot keep up with the leg
power she has gained through her Awakening.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
In other words, her body simply
cannot keep up with her innate talent yet.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Even once the injury has fully healed, until her body finishes growing,
we should proceed with training very cautiously.
An injury right when the Classic year was just getting underway. What's more, discovering a constitutional issue she would have to live with going forward—

"It must have really hit her hard. Marvelous Sunday was dead silent,
a complete 180 from her usual self,
leaving me at a loss on how to cheer her up..."

The next day, based on what the doctor had told us,
we decided to discuss our Classic Year goals.

If we follow the doctor's advice, it'll be difficult to get in as much practice as her rivals.
Aiming for major races would be tough too.
choice_data_list: It's unfortunate, but let's scrap our plans for now and――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Too bad? Why's that?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. What kind of race schedule
did you have planned before my injury?"
choice_data_list: Running graded races while keeping the Triple Crown in mind...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean it's completely impossible?
Like, not even worth trying?

We can't make that call right now.
Our top priority is healing the injury and going through rehab.

And on top of that, how much could her abilities grow
with limited training afterwards?
choice_data_list: To be honest, that part is an unknown factor—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Then it's not "unfortunate" at all, right?☆
After all, the possibility isn't completely gone!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Besides, we'll do training that isn't overbearing! Once I've built up strength, I'll enter a race!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Isn't that completely aligned with the path to our dream from the "World Marvelous Project"?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's why I made it! ☆
Namely, the "World Marvelous Project"! ★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Number one☆
Train lots and lots to get a marvelous and strong stride!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Step two☆
Use that running style to enter bigger and bigger races!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Then there's no need to rush☆
It's not like we're standing still★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"I might have slowed down a bit!
But I can still walk steadily toward my dream!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, couldn't we look at it like this?
It's great that we learned what to watch out for
before you got a much worse injury!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
This injury was surely something
I needed right now!
Which means I can definitely overcome it!â

And so, Marvelous Sunday taught me once again
how to see the world
in a more positive light.

"It's not as though she can't run anymore.
If we look, I'm sure we can find plenty of training methods that don't put strain on her legs."

"Then let's treat the Classic year as one of patience,
aim to bloom in the Senior year,
and do everything we possibly can right now. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Someday, we're definitely gonna race
at our absolute best!☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, where should we go? I'm so excited!
Where do you want to go, Trainer?
It depends on how well the injury heals, making it hard to decide on the next race right now, but having a goal to work toward is essential.

If she takes on a race without overreaching, it should be her specialty, Medium distance.
And for a graded race at the end of the year fitting to cap off this year's goals—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"The Challenge Cup!
What a wonderful, motivating name! ☆★☆
That's the GIII at the end of the year, right?"
choice_data_list: Let's test our skills there before Senior year

text_block_list.text:
What we must wait for now is recovery from her injury
and bodily growth. I suggest setting our concrete goals far
ahead and steadily building up our efforts toward them.

"My true goal is to shine in the Senior year.
With that in mind, I decided to make the Classic year
a year of growth."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer!!
There's no reason to hang your head at all.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Stretching out right in front of us, forever and always,
is a marvelously bright road☆
